behavior: A download whose bytes do not match the pinned archive's checksum is rejected with an explicit checksum-mismatch error and leaves no installed directory — it is never extracted or installed as if valid.
rationale: INV-PROV-2's 'verifying its checksum' half is only observable by feeding corrupt bytes through the real fetch boundary and asserting the checksum guard rejects them; a removed guard would silently install the corrupt archive and stay green on every valid-download condition — the exact gap the checker named.
